subject: Decision: Neighbors architecture for launch review
body:
Team,

Decision from this morning's review: we go with the Neighbors architecture and drop inpainting from the launch-review scope. Wei's sparsity results made this straightforward — the product case is exactly where inpainting is weakest. Inpainting stays in the repo as a research artifact.

Within Neighbors, we're taking the n2 per-language-group configuration as default, with per-language n1 fine-tuning reserved for the five highest-priority languages. Katya's runs showed n2 within a point of n1 on the families that matter, and one model per family is far easier for the translation team to consume.

Remaining path to launch review: lexicon sample scored and delivered by 7/1, review the week after. Nikhil, please schedule the Evalline slot with Tomas' team.

Priya
